scope: Canonical 24 ft / 2500 kg boat: instantaneous inertia, integration allocation and one nonlinear pressure snapshot. No open-water or sustained trajectory qualification.

same_panel_domain_comparison.limitation: Finite tank bias and spatial errors can cancel. Neither P1 nor P0 has reached a six-axis spatial plateau.

single_layer_quadrature_cause.conclusion: Order-three outer integration creates substantial negative curvature after diagonal equilibration; not a raw-scale roundoff failure. No stabilization applied.

target_row_quadrature.rule: Order six for every source contribution in a target row with maximum-edge/height > 10; order three otherwise. Symmetrize V once, derive curl energy from that V. No interaction truncation.

failure.message: Error reported by dpotrf in cuSOLVER. devInfo = [669]. Please refer to the cuSOLVER documentation.

target_row_quadrature.limitation: Threshold changes may create derivative noise elsewhere. Current snapshot h/h2 checks do not qualify all crossings. Candidate not adopted into moving defaults. Static timing precomputes target classification/high-order samples; moving wrapper includes their current-geometry construction in RHS cost.

observed_geometry_repeat.implementation: One byte per target row, replacing the earlier duplicated row-by-source mask without changing classification.
observed_geometry_repeat.limitation: Three warm samples per candidate, sequential; GPU clock/thermal variation means these are component observations, not guaranteed speedups.

next_check: Resolve exterior-domain and spatial errors; test stable material bulk/cut-fringe geometry and guarded operator reuse on this same boat/sea. Target-row integration remains an experimental candidate, not a public accuracy-qualified policy.

matched_moving_integration_check.limitation: Short 12x6x2 m tank pilot, two accepted steps, coarse parent state and exploratory tolerances. Candidate remains above 20x in this run. This is neither sustained ocean throughput nor improvement over the older, lower-accuracy uniform-q3 pilot. Sequential GPU clock/thermal variation is uncontrolled.
